request.style: English, male baritone voice, solo, acoustic guitar, steel guitar, fiddle, banjo, warm and earnest mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Repay no one evil for evil
Give careful thought to what is honorable
Do not be wise in your own eyes
Associate with the lowly, stay humble
[Chorus]
If it is possible, as far as it depends on you
Live at peace with everyone
Do not be overcome by evil
Overcome evil with good
[Verse]
Bless those who persecute you
Bless them and do not curse them
Rejoice with those who rejoice
Weep with those who weep, be one
[Chorus]
If it is possible, as far as it depends on you
Live at peace with everyone
Do not be overcome by evil
Overcome evil with good
[Verse]
If your enemy is hungry, feed him
If he is thirsty, give him something to drink
You will heap burning coals on his head
Leave room for God's wrath, dear friends
[Chorus]
If it is possible, as far as it depends on you
Live at peace with everyone
Do not be overcome by evil
Overcome evil with good
[Bridge]
Vengeance is mine, I will repay
Says the Lord, the only judge
Do not take revenge, dear friends
Trust in His perfect, holy love
[Outro]
Live at peace with everyone
Overcome evil with good
